# KCH Mu Transmuter SCPP

Implement the capabilities fully; do not subordinate them to one experiment. Use onboarding as the
first governed experimental test, not as their definition or evidence of prospective utility.

## Composition

- Preserve `mu_EQ` persistence/hysteresis and obsolete-regime memory.
- Preserve `mu_QE` conjugate-current coherence and rupture signals; retain its adverse historical
  results and `SHADOW_ONLY` routing authority until a new gate changes that state prospectively.
- Keep canonical Transmuter v0.2 and v0.3.2 as separate lineages; never average them into one winner.
- Build the three declared temporal layers and the octet as a joint, irreducibility-tested object.
- Apply SCPP before deliberation to prohibit predeclared inadmissible transitions.
- Use MIS/RGG and KCH for relations, jurisdiction, evidence, rollback and promotion; do not transfer
  authority merely because a bridge executes.

## Evaluation

1. Predeclare semantic jurisdictions; seeds are replicas, never jurisdictions.
2. Keep quantitative results separate from architectural adjudication.
3. Preserve local losses, ties, abstentions and `NOT_ESTIMABLE`; keep `global_winner=null` absent a
   valid global claim.
4. Test component, composition, induced-failure, interruption, recovery and lineage-specific
   promotion gates.
5. Treat historical onboarding as software/integration evidence only. Require prospective holdout
   work for scientific benefit, routing authority, continual learning or end-to-end causal claims.

PHL may learn only toward future successors under its own authorized protocol; it never rewrites
historical outcomes.
